More importantly, we found the interaction effect of Position × Session, F (1, 15) = 3.79, p < 0.05, η2
partial = 0.17: the post-training session showed greater P200 amplitude in response to even-position digits (3.08 ± 0.96 μV) compared to odd-position digits (1.34 ± 0.80 μV), p < 0.05 (Fig. 4).
